DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML)

The patient presents with the classic triad of fatigue, pallor, and petechiae, confirmed by lab results showing pancytopenia (low hemoglobin and platelets) alongside a marked leukocytosis (WBC 81,000) and significant splenomegaly. I am ruling out the instruction to diagnose iron deficiency anemia, as the white blood cell count is far too elevated for that condition. I will proceed to check for the Philadelphia chromosome to confirm the diagnosis.
